title: Another helping is waiting
lesson: A whole new row arrives when its front row is completely empty.

tutorial_guide.title: Make a little room
tutorial_guide.body: Move the tomato to its matching pair. Watch the first tray: its waiting corn stays hidden while a mushroom remains.

tutorial_guide.title: Move the very last piece
tutorial_guide.body: Move the last mushroom out. The whole waiting row will slide forward, and its three corn pieces will match by themselves.

tutorial_complete: An empty front brings the whole next row forward. A waiting triple clears automatically, so one move can make several matches.
